description: Query ranked leaderboard entries by timeframe (daily, weekly, all-time) and scope (public vs social follows).

main.description: Returns ranked entries for a `games.opengaming.leaderboard.definition`, filtered by timeframe, cryptographic verification, publisher `games.opengaming.revocation` records, and social graph.

timeframe.description: Time window derived from `recordedAt` (must be one of the definition's `timeframes`).

scope.description: `public` returns global scores; `social` filters to `viewer` and accounts `viewer` follows (`app.bsky.graph.follow`).

viewer.description: Optional viewer DID used to compute `social` scope and return `viewerEntry`.

verifiedOnly.description: When true, excludes unsigned, invalidly signed, or publisher-revoked (`games.opengaming.revocation`) score records.

viewerEntry.description: The `viewer`'s own best non-revoked entry in the requested timeframe, if any.

attestationCid.description: Computed repository-bound attestation CIDv1 of the score record.

verified.description: True if inline signature verification against the publisher's `#attestations` DID key succeeded AND no matching `games.opengaming.revocation` exists.

revoked.description: True if revoked by a `games.opengaming.revocation` record in the publisher's repository (only returned when `verifiedOnly` is false).
